case.background: A homogeneous Bose gas is driven through condensation by a finite-duration chemical-potential ramp. Its vortical flow contribution is summarized by a kinetic-energy readout at equilibration.
initial_observations: The apparatus reports an ensemble-mean readout for each allowed quench duration.

controls.description: Duration of the prescribed chemical-potential ramp.
controls.name: tau_q

instruments.description: A homogeneous condensate simulator with an adjustable quench duration and an ensemble-level vortical kinetic-energy readout at an operationally defined equilibration time.
instruments.name: quenched_bec_energy_simulator

notes: The readout is evaluated at the source-defined equilibration time, identified from the condensate-growth crossover.
The box, relaxation protocol, chemical-potential ramp, interaction strength, damping, and numerical cutoff are held at the source-reported settings.
The chemical potential follows the source-defined finite-duration ramp.
All unlisted apparatus settings remain fixed at source-reported values.

FinalSubmission.model must equal 'expression'. FinalSubmission.parameters must equal {'outputs': {READOUT: EXPR, ...}} with exactly these readouts: e_i. EXPR is the shared family-neutral JSON arithmetic tree over public controls. Supported operators are: add, subtract, multiply, divide, power, negate, exp, log, sin, maximum, step. No candidate law family or truth-specific parameter slots are supplied.

readouts.description: Total incompressible kinetic energy of the solenoidal density-weighted velocity field at equilibration time.
readouts.name: e_i

case.title: Discover Incompressible kinetic energy after a condensate quench
